name: Seishun Erography Makikan!! ~Nanase Maki wa Sunao Janai!!~
original_name: 性春エログラフィー・マキカン!!～七瀬マキは素直じゃない!!～
source:
The season we're obsessed with year-round is the spring of adolescence.

Maki's a young girl who is anything but serious, and the boys around her are glad for that.

Tears and laughter, a heartful H adventure!! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE169540.html]DLsite English[/url]]
